# ProPublica

> > Independent, nonprofit investigative journalism in the public interest, featuring data-driven reporting, local newsroom partnerships, and accountability journalism.

ProPublica is a Pulitzer Prize-winning newsroom producing investigative stories on government accountability, corporate misconduct, environmental issues, criminal justice, and public health. The organization operates the Local Reporting Network, fostering community journalism partnerships across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Investigative journalism
- Public interest reporting
- Local Reporting Network
- Accountability journalism
- Data-driven investigations
- Government oversight
- Corporate accountability
- Criminal justice reform
- Environmental reporting
- Healthcare investigations
- Election integrity
- Community journalism partnerships
- Visual storytelling
- Interactive journalism
- Design system and brand guidelines

- [ProPublica — Investigative Journalism and News in the Public Interest](https://www.propublica.org): Homepage for independent nonprofit investigative journalism newsroom

## Major Investigations

- [How 3M Execs Convinced a Scientist the Forever Chemicals She Found in Human Blood Were Safe — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/3m-forever-chemicals-pfas-pfos-inside-story): Kris Hansen's PFAS discovery suppressed by 3M Corporation executives
- [Operation Encore and the Saudi Connection: A Secret History of the 9/11 Investigation — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/9-11-investigation-saudi-connections-operation-encore-fbi): FBI Operation Encore investigated Saudi Arabia's possible 9/11 role
- [Election Skeptics Target Voting Officials With Ads in Swing States — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/2024-election-certification-ads-georgia-wisconsin-pennsylvania): Follow the Law group targets Wisconsin, Pennsylvania voting officials
- [40 Million People Rely on the Colorado River. It's Drying Up Fast. — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/40-million-people-rely-on-the-colorado-river-its-drying-up-fast): Colorado River crisis threatens Lake Mead and 40M people's water supply
- [$1.1 Billion in Drug, Device Payments to Doctors Not Included in New Federal Database — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/1.1-billion-in-drug-device-payments-to-doctors-not-included-in-new-database): Investigation reveals Open Payments database missing $1.1B in payments

## Criminal Justice & Legal Reporting

- [33 Years After Dubious Evidence Helped Convict Him, Joe Bryan Has Been Released on Parole — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/33-years-after-dubious-evidence-helped-convict-him-joe-bryan-has-been-released-on-parole): Joe Bryan paroled after conviction based on flawed bloodstain analysis
- [4 Ways Research Has Reframed the Abortion Debate — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/4-ways-research-has-reframed-the-abortion-debate): Turnaway Study findings challenge abortion debate assumptions

## Corporate & Financial Accountability

- [5 Ways GE Plays the Tax Game — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/5-ways-ge-plays-the-tax-game): GE corporate tax avoidance strategies reduce rate below 35 percent
- [15 Banks and 1 Insurance Company Get Bailout Funds — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/15-banks-and-1-insurance-company-get-bailout-funds): TARP bailout recipients including Hartford Financial Services detailed

## Government & Policy

- [40 Acres and a Rule: Draft Federal Fracking Regs Cover Only A Sliver of Land — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/40-acres-and-a-rule-draft-federal-fracking-regs-cover-only-a-sliver-of-land): Obama BLM fracking regulations apply to limited federal lands only
- [3 Things Mayor de Blasio and AG Schneiderman Didn't Say About Housing Enforcement — ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org/article/3-things-mayor-de-blasio-schneiderman-didnt-say-about-housing-enforcement): NYC rent-stabilization enforcement claims lack critical context
